scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm fixtures:verify && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.test:integration: RUN_MONGO_TESTS=1 RUN_NETWORK_TESTS=1 RUN_REDIS_TESTS=1 nx run-many -t test --projects=@lara/data-store,@lara/jobs,@lara/api,@lara/collector --skip-nx-cache
scripts.dev:collector:doppler: doppler run --project lara-backend --config dev_personal --only-secrets NXAPI_KEY --no-fallback -- sh -c 'test -n "$NXAPI_KEY" || exit 1; export NEXON_API_KEY="$NXAPI_KEY"; unset NXAPI_KEY; exec pnpm dev:collector'
